summary: Lemhi County L-4 cab lookout built in 1934 and abandoned in 1962; sources list it as gone and describe no remains.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1962; sources list it as gone and do not describe what remains
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service; sources name the Salmon National Forest or the Challis National Forest

visit.trail_note: Listed as a hike-in site on Idaho Fire Lookouts; the lookout is gone

events.note: L-4 cab on the north point
Forest Service fire spotter at the lookout in August 1953
Fire spotter taken ill; four smokejumpers packed him out by stretcher

evidence.supports: built 1934 as an L-4 cab atop the north point; abandoned 1962; gone
evidence.quote: 1934: L-4 cab atop north point. Abandoned 1962. Gone.

evidence.supports: a Forest Service fire spotter was at the lookout
evidence.quote: A forest service fire spotter was under observation here

evidence.supports: Carl Rennaker of Salmon fell ill at the lookout
evidence.quote: Carl Rennaker, of Salmon, was taken ill Tuesday at Martin Mount lookout
his wife radioed Challis forest officials for help

evidence.supports: four smokejumpers dispatched from Idaho City
evidence.quote: four smokejumpers were dispatched from Idaho City

evidence.supports: a medical student among the jumpers diagnosed acute appendicitis
evidence.quote: One of the jumpers, a medical student, diagnosed Rennaker's illness as acute appendicitis.

evidence.supports: rescuers packed him out by stretcher
evidence.quote: The smokejumpers packed the sick man by stretcher

evidence.supports: trail about nine miles long, about seven hours
evidence.quote: a forest service trail about nine miles from the lookout took about seven hours for the four rescuers

evidence.supports: 1953 newspaper put the lookout 50 miles northwest of Challis
evidence.quote: The lookout is 50 miles northwest of Challis.

evidence.supports: the 50-mile item appeared in the Post-Register in August 1953
the Forest Service now calls the forest Salmon-Challis National Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com names the Salmon National Forest and Forest Lookouts names the Challis National Forest; the Forest Service now uses the Salmon-Challis National Forest name
firelookout.com gives 32 miles northwest of Challis; a 1953 newspaper report, as quoted on Forest Lookouts, gives 50 miles northwest

notes_for_editor: Only short listings and one newspaper-quoting page; no source describes the site today, so the access level is omitted. The forest name and the distance from Challis differ between sources. Record agency 'Challis National Forest' is one of two names in use. The 1953 rescue is an incident, not a fire; it is listed as 'other'. Elevation is in the story but has no facts key in the schema.
